title: Accesses an object's value after std::move — valid-but-unspecified state
notes:
Java and C# have no move semantics; references stay valid until
GC. The trap is that translating naively (Java: pass by reference,
append continues to work) silently CHANGES BEHAVIOUR — the C++
source was implementation-defined; the translation makes the
carry-over branch always fire. SME has to decide whether that's
intended.
